title: Padel Court
mood: furious, proud, ready for the pit
subject: the council turning the town's only skatepark into padel courts
caption: Groove hardcore punk in the genre-blending 2025 style. Chunky palm-muted downtuned guitars playing groove riffs that drop into two-step and half-time breakdowns; a groove-heavy live drum kit with loud floor toms, bursts of d-beat and choked crash cymbals; congas and hand percussion under a dreamy clean-guitar interlude; a warm synth pad swelling under the sung bridge. Raw and roomy, the guitars and drums forward, the bass thick under the riffs. Male voice, a hoarse shouted lead answered by a gang of shouting voices on the hook, switching to a soft reverbed sung voice for the bridge. 168 BPM with half-time breakdowns, D minor. Furious, proud, ready for the pit. No polished pop-punk chorus, no metalcore growls, no thrash-metal shredding or guitar solos, no autotune, no trap drums, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted downtuned riff and floor toms, short]

[Verse 1]
Twelve years we rode the bowl behind the leisure centre
I broke my wrist on that coping when I was fourteen
Council sent a letter on Monday, exciting news
Now there's chain-link round it and a man with a digger

[Chorus - gang shouts answer]
Padel court! (No!)
Forty quid an hour! (No!)
Where are the kids meant to go?
Padel court! (No!)

[Verse 2]
Glass walls and a booking app
Four dentists in white visors playing doubles
We sat on the kerb with our boards across our knees
Watching them miss the ball

[Breakdown - half-time, gang shouts]
Booking fee! Booking fee!
Ten-minute grace period!

[Chorus - gang shouts answer]
Padel court! (No!)
Forty quid an hour! (No!)
They can keep their little rackets
Padel court! (No!)

[Bridge - clean guitar, congas and a soft synth pad, sung quietly]
Top floor of the multi-storey after six
Nobody parks up there and the concrete's smooth

[Outro - full band, last breakdown, gang shout]
See you on the top floor
Bring a broom!

[Song ends abruptly]
